kit.hero_spec: 1500-piece rotating board, outer frame no larger than 35 x 27 x 2 in (work surface about 33 x 24 in, which fits standard 1500-piece puzzles of about 31.5 x 23.5 in) so the kit carton stays at or under 36 x 28 x 5 in. Sealed solid-pine frame on P2 MDF with felt or smooth sealed surface, 6 drawers with stops and magnetic closures, removable low-profile lazy susan with a rotation lock (stores flat), rigid hinged or lift-off hardboard cover, pre-assembled. Target weight 12 lb or less. Compare: ALL4JIG 1500 at $71.99 is 36.8 x 27.4 x 2.1 in, 4.4 kg, unfinished NZ pine, soft translucent cover, drawers without stops (ASIN data, roundup reviews). Certifications: none required for a non-electrical adult accessory beyond TSCA Title VI formaldehyde compliance for the MDF (ASSUMED; verify). Avoid the pivot-arm tilt mechanism (US 12576331).

landed.delivery_path: No US-stock, blind-shipping private-label board supplier was found. Workable path: buy 50-200 kits FOB Qingdao, ship by LCL to a US 3PL, and ship each order by UPS/FedEx Ground. A 50-kit first batch costs about 50 x ($45 product + $27.50 duty and inbound) = about $3,600 before any ad spend, double the $1,800 total budget. Amazon MCF Large Bulky is $39.89 + $0.77/lb above 30 lb (37 lb gives about $45.28 + 3.5% fuel), so it is no cheaper (amzprep.com 2026 MCF guide). VEVOR and Jumbl ship from US stock but are other brands (reselling only).
landed.carton_dims_in: Design target 36 x 28 x 5 in (kit). Reference cartons: Jumbl 1500 rotating board 34.8 x 27 x 4.5 in at 22 lb (Target estimated ship dims); Kdgarden 6-drawer board 93 x 80 x 6 cm = 36.6 x 31.5 x 2.4 in (width over 30 in triggers UPS Additional Handling); ALL4JIG 1500 board itself is 36.8 x 27.4 x 2.1 in, so its carton is about 38 x 29 x 5 in (ASSUMED); JoyBerri table carton 40.7 x 30 x 5.7 in at 15.01 kg (desertcart listing).

duties.label: ESTIMATED
duties.detail: HTS 9503.00.00 (puzzle accessory): MFN free + Section 301 List 4A 7.5% if covered (unconfirmed) + 12.5% Section 301 forced-labor tariff on Chinese goods from 2026-07-24 (polsinelli.com, chrobinson.com via search). If classed as 4421.99.98 (wood article; Kdgarden lists HS 4421999090): 3.3% MFN + 25% List 3 + 12.5% = 40.8%. IEEPA tariffs invalidated 2026-02-20 (Learning Resources v. Trump); the Section 122 10% surcharge was scheduled to expire 2026-07-24. Confirm with a customs broker.

landed.certification: Board: none beyond formaldehyde (TSCA Title VI / CARB P2) documentation for MDF (ASSUMED requirement; verify). Not a children's product: market to adults 14+, though Kdgarden lists CPC. USB LED bar: FCC Part 15 SDoC from the supplier; no UL needed if it is USB-powered with no included adapter and no battery (ASSUMED).
landed.notes: Shipping decides the economics. Each extra inch that pushes the carton past L+G 105 in or a 30 in second side adds UPS Additional Handling ($36 x 1.059, with a 40 lb minimum billable weight), roughly +$50 per order. 2000-piece boards (42 x 31 x 5) and tables with legs (41 x 30 x 6) both trigger it: $95.94 and $97.62 at a 40% discount in zone 5. Inbound LCL for 50 kits adds about $21 per unit. Returns of an oversize box cost another ~$40 and are not in refund_pct.

fit.customer: Adult hobby puzzlers, mostly women 45-75, who do 1000-1500-piece puzzles on the dining table and want them off it between sessions, plus their adult children buying a gift ("gift for mom/grandma" is in nearly every top title). Not the desk/tech-worker customer Dhruv knows first-hand.
fit.positioning: "The puzzle station that ships complete": a lighter, pre-assembled board with drawers that stay shut, a rigid lid and a flat-storing base, plus the trays, light and first puzzle that ALL4JIG sells separately. The problem: ALL4JIG's own DTC charges $87-132 for the board alone, so a $149 kit has little headroom once freight is paid.
fit.software_edge: Photo-to-puzzle builder with a live preview (custom puzzle upsell); a fit checker that reads puzzle box dimensions and confirms the board fits; a puzzle-library tracker and reorder prompts; automated delay notices for the 3PL. Useful, but none of it removes the shipping cost.
fit.reorder: Puzzles: premium 1000-piece wholesale (Cobble Hill MSRP $19.99-24.99) or POD custom photo puzzles (Printful 1000 pcs $29.25 + ~$8.29 ship), which must sell at $49+ to make money while Amazon custom 1000-piece puzzles sell at $27.99-31.99 (B0FQ68H69Q 800+/mo). Glue sheets and frames. Google: custom photo puzzle 12,100/mo (Dec 33,100), 1000 piece puzzles 12,100, puzzle glue 22,200, puzzle of the month club 1,000.
fit.seasonality: January is strong, not dead. Puzzle board: Dec 90,500, Jan 60,500 (67% of Dec, equal to Nov), Feb 33,100, Jun trough 18,100. Puzzle table: Dec 110,000, Jan 74,000, Feb 40,500. Jigsaw puzzle: Nov-Dec 301,000, Jan-May 246,000. Puzzle glue peaks in January at 49,500 (1.5x Dec) as Christmas puzzles get finished; National Puzzle Day searches hit 14,800 in Jan. The Jan 4 test week is good; demand roughly halves by February.
risks: Freight: 37 lb billable per order ($35-48 at an assumed 40% discount, $53-75 at list, zones 4-6); one inch too big triggers Additional Handling (+~$50)
Cash: a 50-kit first batch landed in a US 3PL is about $3,600, double the $1,800 total budget; no US-stock blind-ship private-label source found
ALL4JIG holds 50-61% of premium units with 9,875 reviews and also sells DTC at $87-132
Price above the proven band: boards over $100 barely sell on Amazon; $130+ volume is tables, which ship even worse
Tariffs: 12.5% to 40.8% on China content depending on HTS
Patents on tilt-and-rotate mechanisms and several design patents
Oversize returns and transit damage (warp, cracked frames) with a ~$40 return label

proposed_pts.demand_note: 28,700+ premium units/mo on Amazon (floor), 42,850 total, Google 40-50K/mo each for puzzle board/table; but our $149 board-kit price sits above where boards sell
proposed_pts.supplier_note: Many factories (Kdgarden audited, $14.50-16.50 FOB) but no US-stock blind-ship private-label source; a stocked 3PL needs about 2x the total budget
proposed_pts.differentiation_note: Fixable complaints (stops, rigid lid, flat storage, pre-assembly) plus kit; ALL4JIG's variant breadth and 9.9K reviews dominate
proposed_pts.risk_note: Oversize freight and returns, damage in transit, 12.5-40.8% tariffs, tilt patent US 12576331, cash beyond budget
proposed_pts.ad_note: Spin, drawers, lid and finished-puzzle reveal demo well; IG puzzle creators exist; NeoCup ads ran 209-240 days; no CPA proof

verdict.call: reject for Milestone 1 (revisit only with a US-stock private-label supplier quote and a carton at or under 36x28x5 in)
top_unknowns: Real per-order outbound rate for a 36x28x5 in, about 24 lb carton from a 3PL or rate aggregator (base assumes 40% off UPS list; at UPS list the base kit is $-12.60 pre-ad (economics.py variant pz-base-listship))
Whether any supplier holds US stock and blind-ships a private-label board for $55 or less delivered (even then it fails the cushion at $149: 0.91)
HTS classification and current duty stack (9503 at about 12.5-20% versus 4421.99 at 40.8%)
